Confidential mode, the patent gate, and the audit log

Screens 7–9 and 11. Two of these prevent an irreversible mistake: a tenant where public sharing does not exist as a code path, and a gate before the first public posting that states plainly what disclosure does to a patent. The audit log is the third leg of Camille's evaluation.

VISIBILITY STATES AVAILABLE IN THIS TENANT
PRIVATE LAB TENANT PUBLIC EMBARGOED
Public is not disabled by a permission check. In a confidential tenant the public visibility state does not exist as a value — there is no code path that writes it, so there is no misconfiguration, no admin override and no bug that can produce it.
ALSO ABSENT FROM THE INTERFACE
External deposit to Zenodo or Dryad
Preprint posting
DOI minting
Share cards and embeds
Search-engine indexing
Cross-institution collaboration requests
The public transparency report
AI training options · all of them
Removed from the interface entirely rather than greyed out. A disabled button still teaches a user that the capability exists and invites them to ask for it.
WHY THE ENTIRE CHROME CHANGES
A researcher working across a public tenant and a confidential one in the same afternoon will paste the wrong thing into the wrong window if the two look alike. The dark blue ground, the permanent header bar and the changed accent are all one signal: you are somewhere else, and the rules are different.
WHO USES THIS
Industry-sponsored work under a contract that forbids disclosure, pre-patent research, clinical data under a restrictive DPA, and defence-adjacent work subject to export control. Roughly one lab in eight at a research university.
SWITCHING A TENANT
Standard → confidential is available and takes effect immediately. Confidential → standard is not self-service — it needs a signed instruction from the institution, because the reverse direction can expose work that was created on a promise it never would be.

8 PRE-DISCLOSURE PATENTABILITY GATE (M08, N21) 1440 × 640 · before the first public posting · type-to-confirm on the secondary action
BEFORE YOU MAKE THIS PUBLIC DS-1174 · first public posting from this project
Publishing this destroys your ability to patent it in Europe.
Under the European Patent Convention, any public disclosure before a patent application is filed becomes prior art against your own invention. It destroys novelty. There is no general grace period in Europe — unlike the United States, where a twelve-month grace period exists, in Europe the loss is immediate and cannot be undone by filing later.
WHAT COUNTS AS DISCLOSURE
Making this dataset, method card or figure public here
A preprint, a conference poster, a talk with slides, a thesis in a library
A tweet describing the result in enough detail to enable it
Sharing with a named collaborator under a confidentiality agreement does not count. Lab and Institution visibility on this platform do not count.
Your technology transfer office has not seen this
No invention disclosure has been filed for this project. If there is any chance of commercial value, a fifteen-minute conversation now costs nothing and cannot be had afterwards.
To publish anyway, type PUBLISH below. This is deliberately slower than clicking.
type PUBLISH to confirm
WHY THIS MODAL EXISTS
Loss of patent rights through premature disclosure is one of the most common and most expensive mistakes in academic research, and it is always made by someone who did not know the rule rather than someone who weighed it. A researcher publishing a dataset at 23:00 is not thinking about the EPC. This is the last moment anyone can tell them.
THE ASYMMETRY IS DELIBERATE
Keep private is the primary: full width, dark, one click. The reversible choice should be the easy one.
Publish anyway requires typing a word. Not to obstruct — to convert an automatic click into a decision the person will remember making.
Both outcomes are written to the audit log with the text shown, so the institution can later demonstrate the researcher was warned.
SHOWN ONCE PER PROJECT, NOT PER FILE
On the first public posting from a project only. A gate that appears on every upload is a gate people learn to dismiss without reading, which is worse than no gate at all.
NOT LEGAL ADVICE, AND IT SAYS SO
The modal carries a line naming the institution's actual TTO contact. We state the rule and point at the person qualified to apply it — the platform is not the advisor.

THE PRIOR-DISCLOSURE CHECK IS THE VALUABLE PART
The audit log is searched for any public posting, preprint or conference upload touching this project. "None found, and here is the evidence" is a statement a TTO can act on — and finding one early is far better than a patent attorney finding it in month nine.
the project is flagged pre-disclosure until they respond
